reason: J.B. Hunt is a multi-mode logistics provider: rail intermodal, dedicated contract trucking, brokerage with third-party carriers, final-mile delivery, and a digital freight platform. Heartland Express is a mostly asset-based truckload carrier (dry van, dedicated, expedited, regional). The two overlap in over-the-road and dedicated truckload for large shippers in retail, consumer goods and manufacturing. Heartland has no intermodal, brokerage or final-mile business, which are material parts of the target. A comp that matches only one of the target's material businesses scores at most 1.
